conclusion_boundary: Locally-executable MA items are now resolved (MA-06 gitleaks PASS via user commit ec6501adc, MA-09 knip PASS, MA-10 docs-web build PASS, MA-11 electron build PASS, MA-12 axe PASS with a real serious violation found and fixed); a NON-CONFORMANT classification would also be defensible only if the authorised-environment items were counted as failures. BLOCKED is selected because the dominant, evidence-backed condition is that key verification cannot be completed at all due to an unapproved normative baseline and missing authorised environments. In no case may CONFORMANT be used.
